description: This Dart file defines a custom app theme for a Flutter application. It constructs a ThemeData object with specific colors, typography, and widget styles, including input decorations, buttons, chips, navigation bars, and progress indicators, based on a defined color palette.

classes.name: ColorScheme
classes.description: A comprehensive color palette for light or dark themes, providing colors for primary, secondary, surface, background, and other UI elements.

classes.name: ThemeData
classes.description: An overall theme configuration for a Flutter app, including color schemes, text themes, and widget-specific themes.

classes.name: AppBarTheme
classes.description: Styling settings for AppBar widgets, such as background and foreground colors.

classes.name: CardTheme
classes.description: Styling options for Card widgets, including color, shape, and border.

classes.name: InputDecorationTheme
classes.description: Default styling for input fields, including borders and padding.

classes.name: ElevatedButtonThemeData
classes.description: Styling for ElevatedButton widgets, such as background, shape, and padding.

classes.name: ChipThemeData
classes.description: Styling for Chip widgets, including colors, shapes, and borders.

methods.name: _hex
methods.description: Converts a hex color string (e.g., '#2563EB') to a Flutter Color object.

methods.name: buildAppTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured with a custom color palette and styling for a Flutter app.
